title: Essentially constant filtered ind-diagram
statement: Let J be a filtered category, C a category, and F : J \to C a functor. We say that F is essentially constant with value X in the ind-category if there are morphisms p_j : F(j) \to X natural in j, an index j0 and a morphism s : X \to F(j0) with p_{j0} composed with s equal to the identity of X, and such that for every j there is an index k receiving morphisms from j0 and j for which the transition map F(j) \to F(k) equals the composite F(j) \to X \to F(j0) \to F(k), where the first map is p_j, the second is s, and the last two maps are induced by the chosen morphisms in J.
